maps.points.swamp.dialogue: Event opening (There are still enemies alive (Evil Ent))
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-10: Do you know anything about the fog maze? (Have arrived at the Misty Maze, Have not yet left the Misty Maze)
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-11: Will you join us again? (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-12: We have met this strange creature. (Depending on the progression of the story, this can only be selected once)
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-13: Choose “We have met this strange creature.”
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-14: Grgla gasps, his eyes growing even wider.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-15: He claps excitedly, then lowers his voice to a whisper.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-16: "Good friend. Big friend. Hungry friend... but good friend."
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-17: "You not hurt friend, yes? Friend gets scared... then bites."
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-20: "Grgla was... someone. Long ago. Had name. Had hands. Had warm place."
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-21: His mouth twists. "Swamp took name. Left Grgla. Grgla enough."
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-22: Choose “You have a lot of things in your hide. Do you sell anything?”
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-23: "Stuff is Grgla's. Found things. Lost things. Dead things."
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-24: "But maybe... maybe Grgla trades. For shiny coins. For food. For not hurting Grgla."
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-25: Choose “Do you know anything about the fog maze?” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-26: "Mmm... Grgla knows. Sneaky path through the fog."
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-27: "Grgla show you. Yes, yes... Grgla comes with you."
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-28: He rummages through a pile of damp junk and proudly pulls out a foul-smelling dead fish.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-29: "But maybe... little favor for poor Grgla?"
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-3: Grgla slowly crawls from the reeds, eyes darting from trunk to trunk.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-30: "Friend loves fish. If you find friend... give fish, yes?"
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-31: Grgla scratches his head, then sniffs the air.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-33: Choose “Do you know anything about the fog maze?”
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-35: Choose “Will you join us again?” (Have not yet left the Misty Maze)
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-36: Grgla hugs himself and looks toward the misty swamp.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-38: For a moment, something like hope crawls across his face.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-4: He bares too many teeth in what might be a smile.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-40: Choose “Will you join us again?” (Have left the Misty Maze)
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-41: "Again? No, no. Let poor Grgla be."
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-43: Grgla sinks back into the reeds, clutching his treasures close.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-45: It begins to whimper. Wet, broken sounds bubble from its throat, barely forming words.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-5: "Thank you... yes. Good strangers. Sharp strangers. Grgla remembers."
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-50: His eyes widen. The misery draining from them in an instant, replaced by fear.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-51: "You... you brought them... brought them to Grgla..."
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-52: The miserable creature curls tighter into itself, rocking back and forth as if expecting another beating.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-53: Something tears loose beneath the black water. Crooked trees rise from the mire, dripping mud and rotting moss.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-54: Their branches reach outward as hollow green eyes fix upon you.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-55: Without a sound, they move toward you.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-56: At its center lies what looks like nothing more than a moss-covered mound.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-58: Mud and rotting weeds slide from a bloated body stitched together with roots and flesh. A cavernous maw yawns wide, lined with teeth, while dozens of small eyes blink across its misshapen head.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-59: A deep gurgling rolls from somewhere inside the creature.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-63: We don't want any trouble. (once only)
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-64: Try to calm the creature. (Party member required: Slugman, Available once)
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-65: Peer into the Void. (Party member required: Voidcaller, Available once)
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-67: You reach into the creature's mind through the Void.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-68: Something else is there: thin red tendrils wrapped around its thoughts.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-69: They are controlling it. Its hunger is real, but its actions are not entirely its own.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-7: "You again? Grgla sees you. Grgla always sees."
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-71: You speak in the slow croaks of the marshfolk.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-72: The creature hesitates, its countless eyes focus on you for a brief moment.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-74: You sense it is not acting of its own will. Something has poisoned its mind, leaving only an endless hunger.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-76: The creature tilts its enormous head.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-78: The monster stares at you for a long moment.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-82: The creature merely opens its maw wider.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-83: The creature's many eyes suddenly look past you.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-84: With a violent splash it disappears beneath the murky water.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-85: Moments later, thick fleshy tendrils burst from the swamp and lash toward you.
maps.points.swamp.dialogue-9: You have a lot of things in your hide. Do you sell anything?

maps.points.swamp.x14.dialogue-2: It's like we are walking in circles...
maps.points.swamp.x14.dialogue-4: Looks like the same tree we saw a while ago!
maps.points.swamp.x14.dialogue-5: It's like a maze in here...
maps.points.swamp.x14.dialogue-6: We'll wander here for all eternity...
maps.points.swamp.x14.dialogue-7: I swear, we were here just a moment ago.

maps.points.swamp.x21.detail: Grgla: "Finally! Keep going this way, we can't miss it!"

maps.points.swamp.x24.detail-3: This place feels different. Abandoned. Lost.

maps.points.swamp.x34.detail: "No, no... Grgla not go deeper. Too bad there."
maps.points.swamp.x34.dialogue: "No, no... Grgla not go deeper. Too bad there."
maps.points.swamp.x34.dialogue-2: "Friend not well lately. Poor friend. Maybe red roots below. Bad roots."
maps.points.swamp.x34.dialogue-3: "If you see friend... give fish, yes? Best fish. Do not forget."
maps.points.swamp.x34.dialogue-4: He backs into the fog, still muttering. You have no doubt he is heading back to the safety of his hideout.
